name: Bootstrap project rules and task taxonomy
description: Create baseline rules_spec for agents (status transitions, dependency semantics, update restrictions).
notes: Align with backend constraints: completed tasks immutable except summary/related_files; enforce unique active names.
implementation_guide: Run init_project_rules; include naming conventions, dependency type 'blocks' usage, and clear_all_tasks snapshot requirement.
verification_criteria: Rules_version incremented; rules_updated_at set; thought session created; new tasks follow unique-name constraint.
summary: Initialized rules and documented lifecycle/update constraints for tasks.

name: Implement split_tasks selective matching by (project_id, name)
description: Support selective mode: update existing unfinished tasks by name, insert missing, keep completed untouched.
notes: Be careful: if status=completed only allow summary/related_files changes.
implementation_guide: Lookup active tasks by project_id; for each incoming plan item: if existing and not completed, update allowed fields; else insert new. Validate priority 1-5 and unique active names.
verification_criteria: Selective plan updates tasks without duplicating names; completed tasks remain unchanged; deleted tasks not revived.

name: Add clear_all_tasks backup snapshot and soft-delete flow
description: Before clearing unfinished tasks, snapshot tasks+dependencies to task_backups, then soft-delete tasks and remove edges.
notes: Include a safeguard for rate-limited backup storage API; retry with jitter.
implementation_guide: Transaction: create task_backups row, then update tasks set deleted_at where status<>'completed'; delete/soft-delete dependencies referencing deleted tasks.
verification_criteria: Backup contains counts/hash; after clear, completed tasks remain; list/query ignore deleted; dependencies cleaned.

name: Enforce dependency gating in execute_task
description: Prevent in_progress if any 'blocks' dependency not completed; otherwise transition to in_progress.
notes: On failure, set status=blocked and log which blockers remain.
implementation_guide: Fetch blockers via task_dependencies; if any blocker status!=completed -> set status blocked. Else allow transition from planned/ready/blocked to in_progress.
verification_criteria: Attempting execute with unmet blockers results in blocked; with all blockers met transitions to in_progress; no change for deleted tasks.

name: Implement complete_task dependent unblocking logic
description: When completing a task, update dependents whose blockers are all completed from planned/blocked to ready.
notes: Make sure dependents in_progress are not forced to ready.
implementation_guide: After marking task completed (and writing completion_report), query dependents; for each dependent if status in (planned,blocked) and all blockers completed -> set ready.
verification_criteria: Dependents transition as expected; completion requires blockers completed; completed_at set; report stored.

name: Wire up query_task keyword search across name/description/notes
description: Implement project-scoped search by keyword and exact id, ignoring soft-deleted tasks.
notes: Use ILIKE with trigram index if available; fall back to simple contains.
implementation_guide: Normalize query; if looks like cot_tsk_* treat as exact id OR keyword. Always filter project_id and deleted_at is null.
verification_criteria: Search returns only active tasks in project; exact-id lookup works; deleted tasks excluded.
summary: Added keyword/id search with project scoping and soft-delete filtering.

artifacts: query_task supports keyword and id lookup

name: Add list_tasks dependency counts aggregation
description: Include derived dependency counts (incoming/outgoing) in list_tasks results.
notes: Keep list fast; avoid N+1 queries.
implementation_guide: Single query with LEFT JOIN to task_dependencies grouped by task_id/depends_on_task_id; filter deleted_at null.
verification_criteria: Counts match edges; no deleted tasks in results; performance acceptable on 10k edges.

name: Harden update_task restrictions for completed tasks
description: If status=completed allow only summary and related_files updates; refuse others with clear error.
notes: We saw a client try to rename completed tasks during cleanup.
implementation_guide: In update_task handler, branch on current status. For completed: whitelist summary/related_files only. Validate related_files length <=200.
verification_criteria: Completed tasks reject name/priority changes; non-completed tasks still editable per schema; errors are actionable.

name: Investigate intermittent 429s from snapshot storage during clear_all_tasks
description: Audit logs and add backoff for backup upload when rate-limited.
notes: 429s spike around 02:00 UTC; likely shared bucket throttling.
implementation_guide: Inspect task_backups upload code; add exponential backoff with jitter; capture request-id header for audit.
verification_criteria: Retries succeed under simulated 429; no duplicate snapshots; metrics show reduced failure rate.

name: Add audit fields to thought session summaries for verify_task outcomes
description: Standardize verify_task summary payload: tool version, checks run, outcome, and link to task id.
notes: Keep summaries short; store detailed logs elsewhere.
implementation_guide: Update verify_task to write structured summary line and minimal JSON. Include duration_ms and failed_checks count.
verification_criteria: Thought sessions include consistent fields; summaries under 200 chars; no task status mutation.

name: Migrate task IDs to ULID-compatible generator
description: Ensure ids follow cot_tsk_01H8XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX pattern and remain sortable by time.
notes: Preserve existing ids; generator only affects new inserts.
implementation_guide: Swap id generator to ulid; prefix with cot_tsk_. Add tests for uniqueness and monotonicity under concurrency.
verification_criteria: New tasks get expected prefix; no collisions in parallel insert test; ordering roughly follows created_at.
summary: Switched new task id generation to ULID with cot_tsk_ prefix and added concurrency tests.

name: Fix soft-delete uniqueness edge case in split_tasks overwrite mode
description: When overwriting, soft-delete unfinished tasks first, then insert new plan without name collisions.
notes: Bug: transaction order caused unique(project_id,name) conflicts when names reused.
implementation_guide: In overwrite: UPDATE tasks SET deleted_at=now() WHERE project_id=? AND status<>'completed' AND deleted_at IS NULL; then insert new tasks.
verification_criteria: Overwrite succeeds when names reused; completed tasks remain; list_tasks excludes deleted rows.
summary: Reordered overwrite flow to soft-delete unfinished tasks before inserting replacements.

name: Add API guardrails for delete_task refusing completed tasks
description: Ensure delete_task returns 409 when attempting to delete completed tasks; allow others to soft-delete.
notes: Also return 404 when already deleted.
implementation_guide: Check deleted_at first; then if status=completed -> refuse. Else set deleted_at and updated_at; remove dependency edges in same transaction.
verification_criteria: Completed cannot be deleted; unfinished tasks can; dependency edges removed; list/query ignore deleted tasks.

name: Implement get_task_detail with dependency edges
description: Return task row plus incoming/outgoing dependencies within same project; exclude edges involving deleted tasks.
notes: Be explicit about direction: outgoing = blocks on others; incoming = tasks blocked by this one.
implementation_guide: Fetch task by id with project_id and deleted_at null; then query task_dependencies where task_id=id OR depends_on_task_id=id; join tasks for names.
verification_criteria: Detail response includes edges both directions; errors on wrong project; deleted tasks hidden.
summary: Added task detail endpoint including dependency edges filtered to active tasks in-project.

name: Add validation to prevent dependency cycles on update_task
description: Reject updates that introduce cycles in task_dependencies within a project.
notes: Cycle detection can be bounded: max 50 deps per task.
implementation_guide: On dependency update, run DFS from candidate depends_on nodes back to task_id; if reachable, reject. Cache adjacency per request.
verification_criteria: Known cycle cases rejected; non-cycle updates succeed; performance OK under 500 tasks.

name: Create task schema regression tests for lifecycle constraints
description: Add tests: completed_at iff status=completed; deleted_at null or status<>completed; priority bounds.
notes: Include property-based tests for transitions.
implementation_guide: Use Vitest; seed tasks with permutations; validate API rejects invalid states; ensure transitions follow allowed graph.
verification_criteria: Tests cover all statuses; invalid completed_at combinations rejected; CI green.
summary: Added lifecycle and constraint regression tests, covering completion/deletion invariants and priority bounds.

name: Triage customer report: list_tasks missing recently created tasks
description: Investigate caching layer and deleted_at filters causing tasks to disappear.
notes: Report came from 'NimbleOps' workspace; query shows tasks exist but list returns stale cache.
implementation_guide: Inspect Redis keying by project_id; check invalidation on split_tasks/plan_task; verify list filter uses deleted_at is null.
verification_criteria: Root cause identified; fix merged or issue closed as user error.

name: Implement append-only split_tasks mode for incremental planning
description: Append mode must only insert new tasks; never mutate existing tasks.
notes: Ensure name uniqueness within active tasks; reject duplicates cleanly.
implementation_guide: For each incoming task: check (project_id,name) where deleted_at null; if exists -> skip or error based on flag; else insert with planned status.
verification_criteria: Existing tasks unchanged; new tasks inserted; duplicates handled without violating unique constraint.
summary: Added append-only split_tasks mode with uniqueness checks against active tasks.

name: Document clearAllTasks behavior for client SDK
description: Explain snapshot semantics, soft-deletes, and how completed tasks remain after clear.
notes: Include example response payload for backup id and counts.
implementation_guide: Update SDK docs: clearAllTasks -> creates backup, soft-deletes unfinished tasks and dependencies, then inserts plan.
verification_criteria: Docs mention completed tasks preserved; shows handling of rate-limit errors; links to task_backups id.

name: Add server-side guard for max 500 active tasks per project
description: Prevent runaway split_tasks from creating too many non-deleted tasks.
notes: Return 413 or 409 with counts and suggestion to clear tasks.
implementation_guide: Before insert batch, count tasks where deleted_at null; if count + incoming > 500 -> reject and provide current_count and incoming_count.
verification_criteria: Insert rejected when would exceed 500; normal plans succeed; completed and deleted tasks counted correctly.
summary: Implemented per-project active task cap (500) with clear error payloads.

name: Tune DB index for tasks(project_id, deleted_at, updated_at)
description: Improve list/query performance on large projects by adding composite index.
notes: Consider partial index where deleted_at is null for active tasks.
implementation_guide: Add migration for composite index; analyze query plans for list_tasks and query_task; update docs for rollout.
verification_criteria: EXPLAIN shows index usage; p95 latency decreases on staging dataset; migration reversible.

name: Backfill missing related_files for legacy completed tasks
description: Some older completed tasks have empty related_files; populate from git diff hints.
notes: Allowed change: completed tasks can update related_files.
implementation_guide: Script: for each completed task with related_files empty, infer paths from referenced PR numbers in notes; update only related_files and updated_at.
verification_criteria: No changes to name/priority; updated rows track provenance; related_files length <=200.
summary: Backfilled related_files for 19 legacy completed tasks based on PR references; no other fields modified.

name: Create admin endpoint to purge soft-deleted tasks older than 90 days
description: Hard-delete tasks with deleted_at older than retention; leave completed tasks intact.
notes: Make it admin-only and log counts per project.
implementation_guide: Cron job: delete from task_dependencies where task_id/depends_on in purged ids; then delete tasks. Store audit event id.
verification_criteria: Only soft-deleted non-completed tasks are purged; dependencies cleaned; audit log written.

name: Add UX copy for blocked tasks showing unmet blockers
description: Expose blocker task names/ids to clients so UI can show why a task is blocked.
notes: Avoid leaking cross-project info; only join within same project.
implementation_guide: Update execute_task response to include blockers array when transitioning/remaining blocked; include id and name of blockers not completed.
verification_criteria: Blocked response includes accurate blockers; no blockers returned when ready/in_progress; respects project boundaries.

name: Reproduce and fix stale dependency edges after task soft-delete
description: Sometimes task_dependencies rows remain after delete_task, causing list counts to be wrong.
notes: Likely missing transaction in delete_task when dependencies deletion fails.
implementation_guide: Write failing test: create deps, delete task, ensure deps removed. Fix by wrapping in DB tx and using FK cascade or explicit delete.
verification_criteria: After delete_task, no edges reference deleted task; list counts correct; concurrent deletes safe.

name: Add instrumentation for task status transitions
description: Emit metrics and audit event when status changes, including from planned->ready and blocked->ready.
notes: Tag by project_id; include tool name initiating transition.
implementation_guide: In status update helper, emit event to analytics bus; include from/to, task_id, project_id, duration since created_at.
verification_criteria: Events emitted on transitions only; no events on no-op updates; metrics visible in Grafana dashboard.
summary: Added status transition events and metrics, including tool attribution and age-at-transition fields.

name: Close open thought sessions on worker crash recovery
description: Ensure thought_sessions status doesn't remain open if worker dies mid-tool; mark as closed with error summary.
notes: We saw lingering open sessions after deploy rollback.
implementation_guide: On startup, find thought_sessions older than threshold in status=open and mark closed with 'recovered' flag; include last heartbeat.
verification_criteria: No open sessions older than 1h; recovery doesn't touch active sessions; audit logged.

name: Implement task completion report schema v2
description: Add structured fields: checks_run, evidence_links, execution_notes, and durations to completion_report.
notes: Keep report compact; avoid embedding full logs.
implementation_guide: Update complete_task to build completion_report v2; ensure JSON stays small; migrate existing consumers to tolerate missing fields.
verification_criteria: New completed tasks have v2 fields; old rows still parse; report under size limit; completed_at set.
summary: Rolled out completion_report v2 with evidence links and timing fields; consumers updated for backward compatibility.

name: Soft-delete stale cancelled tasks from legacy import
description: Mark old cancelled tasks as deleted to reduce clutter; keep completed tasks intact.
notes: Run once; ensure unique(project_id,name) unblocked for new tasks.
implementation_guide: Admin script: set deleted_at on cancelled tasks older than 180d (and not completed). Log ids to audit.
verification_criteria: Only cancelled tasks affected; completed tasks untouched; list_tasks shows fewer items; audit written.

name: Add safeguard to prevent completing a deleted task
description: complete_task must refuse when deleted_at is set; return 404/410 depending on policy.
notes: We saw a race between delete_task and complete_task in logs.
implementation_guide: In complete_task, fetch task row with FOR UPDATE; if deleted_at not null -> refuse. Also ensure blockers completed.
verification_criteria: Deleted tasks cannot be completed; non-deleted tasks still complete; race test passes.

name: Archive duplicate planning tasks created during incident 2026-04-01
description: Clean up duplicate planned tasks by soft-deleting the extras (non-completed only).
notes: Incident INC-4821 created duplicates due to retry without idempotency key.
implementation_guide: Identify duplicates by same name and created_at window; keep earliest; set deleted_at on others; remove dependency edges.
verification_criteria: Only duplicates deleted; remaining task names unique; no dangling edges; incident noted in audit.
